data.name: Evasion
data.description: If you make a successful Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, you instead take no damage.  Evasion can only be used ifyou are wearing light armor or no armor.  A helpless cryptic does not gain the benefit of evasion.
